=== start  ·  preflight fails
$ orion-node start

 PREFLIGHT
   ✓ Config valid
   ✗ State database is not writable
     │ /var/lib/orion/state.db is owned by root
     │ Fix  sudo chown -R orion /var/lib/orion
   ✓ Permissions

 RECENT SERVICE LOG
   14:21:08 error state: open /var/lib/orion/state.db: permission denied
   14:21:08 error node: exiting

 ERROR  Start preflight failed
   The service was not touched.
$ echo $?
1

=== stop and restart
$ orion-node stop

 ┃ Stop the node on edge-05?
 ┃ Monitoring and log shipping pause until you start it again.
    Stop    Cancel      skip the prompt with --yes

   ✓ Stopped

$ orion-node restart

   ✓ Stopped
   ✓ Started
   ✓ Healthy                      reporting again                                  6 s

=== run
$ orion-node run --once

 ◆ Run  foreground, one cycle

   ✓ Config loaded 5 monitors
   ✓ State database ready
   ✓ Registered
   ✓ One collection cycle complete                                               1.4 s

$ orion-node run

 ERROR  Core rejected this server's credentials
   Reporting stopped. Identity and monitors are kept.
   Fix  orion-node token apply   with a replacement token from the Console

=== service install and uninstall
$ orion-node service install

 The installer sets everything up in one step:

   ▸ curl -fsSL …/orion-node-installer.sh | bash -s -- \
         --core-url <url> --enrollment-token <token>

 Per-user install without root: add --user     Preview: add --dry-run

$ orion-node service uninstall

   ▸ curl -fsSL …/orion-node-installer.sh | bash -s -- uninstall
 Add --purge to remove config and state too.

--- notes
NOTE Preflight before touching anything: Start checks config, state and permissions first. A failure stops before the service is changed and shows the fix and the last service log lines.
NOTE Confirm only what interrupts: Stop asks once on a terminal (Huh confirm); restart and start never ask. --yes and non-TTY skip the prompt.
NOTE Run is for debugging: Foreground node for containers and checks; --once runs one cycle and exits. A rejected credential ends with the recovery command.
NOTE Install hints are copyable: service install and uninstall print the installer line in a block; they never change the system themselves.
NOTE Exit codes: Failures exit 1. A command that needs root exits 3 and says to re-run with sudo.
